requirements.title: TRANSFER argument restrictions
requirements.definition: SOURCE shall be a scalar or array of any type, MOLD shall be a scalar or array of any type, an undefined variable MOLD is allowed, a positive-storage SOURCE with array MOLD requires a scalar of MOLD type and type parameters to have nonzero storage size, SIZE shall be an integer scalar, and the SIZE actual shall not be an optional dummy argument.

pending.TRANSFER-SOURCE-scalar-or-array-any-type: Positive source controls call TRANSFER with scalar integer SOURCE=-17 and rank-one integer SOURCE=[7,-3,11]; source-control mutations supply a procedure designator or non-data entity and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.TRANSFER-MOLD-scalar-or-array-any-type: Positive source controls use scalar integer MOLD=0 and rank-one integer MOLD=[0,0]; source-control mutation supplies a non-data entity and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.TRANSFER-MOLD-variable-need-not-be-defin: Declare integer :: mold_scalar without definition, evaluate TRANSFER([1,2], mold_scalar, SIZE=2), and assert only result type, rank, size, and same-type leading values fixed by p4 and p5.
pending.TRANSFER-positive-source-array-mold-nonz: Use integer SOURCE=[1,2] and integer array MOLD=[0] whose scalar storage size is nonzero; a source-control mutation uses a zero-storage derived-type MOLD array and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.TRANSFER-SIZE-integer-scalar: Use SIZE=2 for integer SOURCE=[5,6,7] and scalar integer MOLD=0; assert rank-one size two and leading values [5,6]. Source-control mutations use noninteger and rank-one SIZE expressions.
pending.TRANSFER-SIZE-actual-not-optional-dummy: Positive wrapper passes a present nonoptional integer n=2 as SIZE; source-control mutation forwards an optional dummy as the SIZE actual and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: TRANSFER result characteristics
requirements.definition: The TRANSFER result has the same type and type parameters as MOLD; scalar MOLD with absent SIZE gives a scalar result, array MOLD with absent SIZE gives a rank-one array whose size is the minimum not shorter than SOURCE, and present SIZE gives a rank-one array of that size.

pending.TRANSFER-result-type-parameters-follow-M: Use integer SOURCE=[1,2] with character(len=3) MOLD='abc' and assert result LEN is three and rank/size follow the selected case; no character value is asserted for cross-type representation.
pending.TRANSFER-scalar-MOLD-absent-SIZE-scalar-: Use integer SOURCE=42 and scalar integer MOLD=0; assign result to an integer scalar sentinel initialized to -999 and assert exact value 42 plus scalar assignment compatibility.
pending.TRANSFER-array-MOLD-absent-SIZE-minimum-: Use integer SOURCE=[4,-5,6] and integer MOLD=[0]; assert rank one, SIZE(result)==3, and values [4,-5,6]. Mutate MOLD rank or expected size.
pending.TRANSFER-present-SIZE-rank-one-given-siz: Use integer SOURCE=[5,6,7], scalar integer MOLD=0, and SIZE=2; assert rank one, SIZE(result)==2, and values [5,6]. Mutate SIZE to three in the expected check.

requirements.title: TRANSFER exact physical-representation portions
requirements.definition: Equal-length result representation equals SOURCE, a longer result has a leading part equal to SOURCE, and a shorter result equals the leading part of SOURCE.

pending.TRANSFER-equal-length-representation-fro: Use same-type integer SOURCE=[-9,4] and MOLD=[0,0] with absent SIZE; assert the two result elements are [-9,4] from a sentinel-filled result variable, then mutate SOURCE order.
pending.TRANSFER-longer-result-leading-part-from: Use integer SOURCE=[10,-20] and scalar integer MOLD=0 with SIZE=4; assert SIZE(result)==4 and first two elements [10,-20], paired with a shorter-result companion; do not assert elements three and four.
pending.TRANSFER-shorter-result-leading-part-fro: Use integer SOURCE=[5,6,7] and scalar integer MOLD=0 with SIZE=2; assert result [5,6], paired with an equal-length companion [5,6,7].

requirements.title: TRANSFER padding representation is processor dependent
requirements.definition: For a result representation longer than SOURCE, the representation after the leading SOURCE portion is processor dependent.

requirements.title: TRANSFER round-trip relations preserve E
requirements.definition: For scalar D at least as long as scalar E, TRANSFER(TRANSFER(E,D),E) has value E; for array D and rank-one array E, TRANSFER(TRANSFER(E,D),E,SIZE(E)) has value E.

pending.TRANSFER-scalar-round-trip-preserves-E: Use same-kind integer scalar variables E=-12345 and D=0; assert TRANSFER(TRANSFER(E,D),E)==E from a sentinel comparison, then mutate the outer MOLD to an array form in a source-control variant.
pending.TRANSFER-array-round-trip-preserves-E: Use integer rank-one E=[7,-8,9] and integer array D=[0,0,0,0]; assert TRANSFER(TRANSFER(E,D),E,SIZE(E)) equals E elementwise, with SIZE(E) mutation to SIZE(E)-1 caught by a shape/value check.
